confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from crowd-sourced 2026 snapshots (Numbeo via Expatica, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan) and are converted from CHF at an assumed 1.25 USD per CHF. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced: cocktail is about 2.1x the beer anchor and wine about 1.2x, based on general Swiss bar pricing. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings, and assumes July peak demand on Lake Lugano. The FX observation (0.6720, 2026-11-18) comes from search-result summaries and was not verified on the RBA page itself. Earlier searches returned conflicting values (0.7088 for March 2026, and third-party figures near 0.70 in late 2026), and I ran two RBA searches rather than one.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lugano-specific price signals for food and drink; cocktail and wine derived from the beer anchor; accommodation from general knowledge of Lugano as a lakeside Swiss tourist city with no listings inspected.
